claims.statement: Provides a reusable ILP layer with learned constraints and costs, retaining a conventional unmodified solver in the forward pass.
Backward pass is a geometric surrogate recombining signed integer directions and hyperplane mismatch gradients, not an ordinary discrete argmin derivative.
Supplementary Proposition S1 assumes differentiable mapping and loss; it does not establish discrete global training convergence.

evidence.locator: Supplement B Proposition S1 and decomposition induction

claims.statement: Four separately trained demonstrations recover constraints or combine learned costs/constraints with features; matching p=4..7 uses separate fixed-size models and trails BB-GM.
The text knapsack implementation fixes true capacity100 and predicts weights/prices within prescribed ranges; true feasibility can fail.
Gurobi solves every forward problem; reported V100 totals cover training and evaluation, with ILP forward runtime dominant.
Reusable modeling layer and distinct fixed-dimension task models do not establish a shared generalist optimizer.

evidence.locator: Scope of layer; different demonstrations; four separate matching architectures
